scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@lzc/api
scripts.dev:login: npm run build:packages && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/local-stackit-login.ts
scripts.dev:chat: npm run build:packages && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/local-assistant.ts
scripts.dev:workstation: npm run build:packages && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/local-workstation.ts
scripts.dev:execution: npm run build:packages && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/local-stackit-login.ts --execution
scripts.knowledge:generate: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/assistant-knowledge.ts
scripts.knowledge:check: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/assistant-knowledge.ts --check
scripts.assistant:generate: npm run knowledge:generate && node --import tsx scripts/assistant-tests.ts --generate
scripts.assistant:check: npm run knowledge:check && node --import tsx scripts/assistant-tests.ts --check
scripts.test:assistant:live: npm run assistant:check && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/assistant-tests.ts
scripts.test:assistant:journey: npm run assistant:check && node --use-system-ca --import tsx scripts/assistant-journey.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace=@lzc/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run tests
scripts.check: npm run assistant:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:common-contract: node scripts/prepare-common-contract.ts && tofu -chdir=../.local/common-contract fmt -recursive && tofu -chdir=../.local/common-contract init -backend=false -input=false -no-color && tofu -chdir=../.local/common-contract validate -no-color && tofu -chdir=../.local/common-contract test -no-color
scripts.test:plan: npm run typecheck && bash scripts/test-plan-summary.sh && bash scripts/test-application-contract.sh && bash scripts/test-governance-contract.sh
